name: Simple File Manager
tagline: Manage your files with no ads and no tracking
description:
Simple File Manager is an easy, ad-free way to browse, move, copy, and organize the files on your phone. There's no tracking and no unnecessary permissions, just a clean file browser that respects your privacy.

It's part of the Simple Mobile Tools family of open source apps, built to be lightweight, fast, and easy for anyone to use.
